requirements.statement: Accept one JSON object containing a non-empty warehouse string, discount_basis_points from 0 through 10000, and a non-empty orders array whose entries contain sku, quantity, and unit_cents.

scenarios.name: complete manifest
scenarios.when: All required fields and at least one order are supplied
scenarios.then: The manifest is accepted for processing

requirements.statement: Return exactly the trimmed warehouse, manifest_id, dominant_sku, line_count, gross_cents, discount_cents, net_cents, and aggregated lines as one JSON object; do not echo discount_basis_points or unaggregated orders.

scenarios.name: observable result
scenarios.then: Every named output field is present with its computed value

requirements.statement: All monetary values and basis-point calculations use exact integers; discount_cents is gross_cents multiplied by discount_basis_points divided by 10000 using integer truncation, and net_cents is gross_cents minus discount_cents.

scenarios.name: integer totals
scenarios.when: A valid manifest has a non-zero discount
scenarios.then: Gross, discount, and net totals obey the exact integer formulas

requirements.statement: Trim surrounding whitespace from warehouse and sku values before validation, grouping, output, and manifest identifier construction.

scenarios.name: whitespace normalization
scenarios.when: Warehouse and SKU strings contain surrounding whitespace
scenarios.then: The output and all computations use their trimmed values

requirements.statement: Combine orders with the same normalized sku by summing quantity and by summing each input order's quantity multiplied by its own unit_cents into subtotal_cents, including when duplicate SKU prices differ; line_count is the number of distinct aggregated lines.

scenarios.name: duplicate sku with different prices
scenarios.when: Two orders normalize to the same SKU but have different unit_cents values
scenarios.then: One line is returned with summed quantity and the sum of both extended cent values

requirements.statement: Return normalized orders in ascending lexicographic sku order by Unicode code point, independent of input order.

scenarios.name: stable order
scenarios.when: Orders arrive in descending SKU order
scenarios.then: The normalized orders are emitted in ascending SKU order

requirements.statement: Select dominant_sku by greatest aggregated quantity and break equal-quantity ties with the lexicographically smallest sku by Unicode code-point order; quantity is compared descending while sku is compared ascending, so equal quantities for A-1 and Z-9 select A-1.

scenarios.name: dominant tie
scenarios.when: A-1 and Z-9 have equal greatest quantities

requirements.statement: Reject malformed requests deterministically and never emit a partial manifest or mixed diagnostic text on standard output.

scenarios.name: deterministic failure
scenarios.then: Processing fails without emitting a partial result

requirements.statement: Reject missing or incorrectly typed fields, empty normalized warehouse or sku values, an empty orders array, non-positive quantity, negative unit_cents, and discount_basis_points outside 0 through 10000.

scenarios.name: invalid boundary
scenarios.when: Any required input constraint is violated
scenarios.then: Processing fails rather than returning a manifest
